ideas.name: Pet Talk
ideas.summary: Chat with a pocket pet that remembers you, reacts to touch and grows over time.

ideas.name: Clock
ideas.summary: A calm desk clock with alarms, a world time view and a gentle night mode.

ideas.name: Album
ideas.summary: Shows a slideshow of photos you send from your phone over Wi-Fi.

ideas.name: Stopwatch
ideas.summary: A precise stopwatch with laps, plus a focus timer for short work sessions.

ideas.name: Squircle Studio
ideas.summary: Draw expressive faces and shapes, then watch them come alive on screen.

ideas.name: Agenda
ideas.summary: Today's events and reminders at a glance, synced from your calendar.

ideas.name: Music
ideas.summary: Plays relaxing tunes and white noise through the built-in speaker.

ideas.name: Hand Speed
ideas.summary: Tap as fast as you can, beat your best score and challenge friends.

ideas.name: Weather
ideas.summary: Live weather for your city: temperature, rain and a 3-day forecast.

ideas.name: Signal Hunter
ideas.summary: Walk around and find the strongest Wi-Fi signal with a live meter.

ideas.name: Pet Forest
ideas.summary: Grow a forest with your pet: every focus session plants a new tree.

ideas.name: Typhoon Monitor
ideas.summary: Tracks nearby typhoons and storm alerts on a live map.

ideas.name: Color Check
ideas.summary: A quick color vision check with test plates and a clear result.

ideas.name: Digital Rain
ideas.summary: A falling-code clock that turns the current time into digital rain.

ideas.name: Skills
ideas.summary: Ask the AI to learn new skills and run them right on the device.

ideas.name: Decision
ideas.summary: Can't decide? Spin the wheel and let it pick for you.

ideas.name: Fortune
ideas.summary: A daily fortune with a compass that points to your lucky direction.

ideas.name: Plane Radar
ideas.summary: See planes flying overhead with their flight number and altitude.

ideas.name: Classic Games
ideas.summary: Five classic arcade games in one, with a high-score table.

ideas.name: Calculator
ideas.summary: A big-button calculator with history and quick unit conversion.

store_only.name: Rolling Maze
store_only.summary: Tilt the device to roll the ball through the maze. Uses the IMU.

store_only.name: Gold Miner
store_only.summary: Swing the hook, grab the gold and beat the clock. Great for quick breaks.

Open the Vibe-coding guide and
follow it in your AI agent.

Plug in USB. The agent installs the
Idea over the cable.
Check Develop for USB and agent status.

help_topics.title: Idea IDs & sharing
steps:
Every Idea has a 6-digit ID shown
on Mosaico Ideas.

Open Manage, tap +, type the ID
and press Go.

Share your own Idea to get an ID
for friends.

help_topics.title: Troubleshooting
steps:
No Wi-Fi? Open Settings and
connect first.

Not enough space? Delete an Idea
in Manage.

Stuck inside an Idea? Hold AI and
press power twice.
